scientific_integrity: All mathematical assertions are supported by an explicit all-length argument and reproducible independent finite checks. Established prior scalar counts and fixed-root enumeration are credited. External independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only linear binary words with exactly two ones and length 2m+2; the 2023 membership criterion and aggregate count S(m) are known. The contribution is exact all-length root-multiplicity distribution, peeling bijection and conditional law. Originality review is not proof of historical uniqueness; finite checker corroborates but does not establish infinite proof.
title: Exact root-multiplicity distribution of binary shuffle squares with two ones
